purpose: Bind a Vera currentness decision to one explicit multi-surface observation cut without promoting currentness into identity, authority, or effect permission.

disposition.CURRENT: all required surfaces COMPLETE and stable across their observed start/end frontiers
disposition.RETRY_AFFECTED_SURFACES: first observation cut contains movement on one or more required surfaces
disposition.UNSTABLE_UNKNOWN: required surface still moves after one bounded retry
disposition.BLOCKED_REQUIRED_SURFACE: required surface is PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE

effect_boundary: A CURRENT disposition is eligibility/currentness evidence only. Any protected or external effect must separately re-admit current authority and target preconditions at its own authorization boundary.
